# CLI reference

Every `nut` command, generated from the same help text `nut --help` prints. Man pages live in [`man/`](../../../man/).

## Monitor

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`nut status`](status.md) | Show UPS status |
| [`nut battery`](battery.md) | Show battery charge and runtime, or run a guarded self-test |
| [`nut events`](events.md) | Show UPS event history |

## Act

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`nut beeper`](beeper.md) | Show or change the UPS beeper |
| [`nut notify`](notify.md) | Send or inspect UPS notifications |

## Set up

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`nut init`](init.md) | Plan or apply NUT configuration |
| [`nut rollback`](rollback.md) | List or restore a configuration backup |
| [`nut config`](config.md) | Inspect, scaffold, render, or diff host settings |

## Prove

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`nut doctor`](doctor.md) | Check UPS protection and recovery readiness |
| [`nut bios`](bios.md) | Guide and verify BIOS recovery settings |
| [`nut drill`](drill.md) | Guide and record a physical outage drill |

## Shell

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`nut completion`](completion.md) | Install, inspect, or remove shell completion |

## Full help

```text
Manage and verify NUT UPS protection

Usage: nut [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
Monitor:
  status       Show UPS status
  battery      Show battery charge and runtime, or run a guarded self-test
  events       Show UPS event history
Act:
  beeper       Show or change the UPS beeper
  notify       Send or inspect UPS notifications
Set up:
  init         Plan or apply NUT configuration
  rollback     List or restore a configuration backup
  config       Inspect, scaffold, render, or diff host settings
Prove:
  doctor       Check UPS protection and recovery readiness
  bios         Guide and verify BIOS recovery settings
  drill        Guide and record a physical outage drill
Shell:
  completion   Install, inspect, or remove shell completion

Options:
  -h, --help              Print help
  -V, --version           Print version
      --ascii              Use ASCII symbols and bars
      --color <WHEN>       Color output: auto, always, or never [default: auto]
  -c, --config <PATH>      Read host settings from this file
  -j, --json              Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose            Include additional diagnostic detail
```
